summary: The change passes. It adds crates/athena-core/src/role_value.rs, which judges a new role against a simpler alternative by reusing method_experiment::compare: the role is worth keeping only if it does better. Empty role names, missing arms, zero bounds and over-bound runs are refused. The module allows retiring a role only when every knowledge item it holds is recorded elsewhere; otherwise it refuses and names the unrecorded items. docs/spec.toml now records this as OLY-9-12's mechanism, keeps owner Athena, and gives the measure `cargo test -p athena-core role_value; status: not shown`, following the OLY-9-05 precedent. I ran the role_value tests (6 passed) and the xtask spec tests (30 passed). The fmt, clippy and test results come from Athena's CI record. All changed files are on the deliverables list. Two small findings: the module is not yet wired into any runtime path, which was out of scope by design, and the knowledge check matches items by exact string.
